diff --git a/fastapi/params.py b/fastapi/params.py
index 6a58d580..ce05ebd4 100644
--- a/fastapi/params.py
+++ b/fastapi/params.py
@@ -768,7 +768,19 @@ class Depends:
     use_cache: bool = True
     scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None
 
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        # This is a workaround to make Depends hashable, to support tools that
+        # interact with FastAPI internals
+        return hash((self.dependency, self.use_cache, self.scope))
+
 
 @dataclass
 class Security(Depends):
     scopes: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        # This is a workaround to make Security hashable, to support tools that
+        # interact with FastAPI internals
+        return hash(
+            (self.dependency, self.use_cache, self.scope, tuple(self.scopes or []))
+        )
